versions.changelog: Agents write the deck as a React/TSX module. Added instructions and templates. Removed generate_deck, edit_deck, and create_brand_from_url.
Narrow SKILL.md description so agents only invoke for Skroll-specific work (SkillSpector SQP-1).

- Initial release of Skroll skill for terminal-based presentation creation and editing
- Supports deck generation, editing, versioning, and PDF/PPTX export via Skroll CLI
- Handles authentication with both OAuth (browser) and API key for headless scenarios
- Provides commands to manage decks, brands, and exports directly from the terminal
- Includes error handling guidance for payment, rate limits, and authentication issues
